messages:
Marta: FYI Catalyst SI just started onboarding Acme Retail for Marketplace private bundle. They ran into a model-serving perf bump during scale tests.
Raj: pinging eng-platform and eng-runtime — it's a memory cliff on the private image (nvml shows OOM-ish).
Chen: share logs? what model + quant config?
Josh (Catalyst SI): We're running rwd-llama-13b-q4 with 6xA10G in dedicated pool. Tail lat spikes at 2.1s -> 6s after ~300 concurrent sessions.
Daniela: can you paste the worker logs and nvidia-smi output? Also confirm KV cache size and sequence length.
Josh (Catalyst SI): pasted snippet: ```stderr: CUDA out of memory at allocate... batch_size=8 seq=2048``` and `nvidia-smi -q` shows 81% mem usage pretest.
Marta: suspect continuous batching config is grouping big sequences. Can you try setting max_batch_size=4 and enable prefix caching?
Raj: also check kernel fallback—older cuBLAS paths can inflate memory. Which runtime commit?
Chen: runtime v0.12.3 -- we backported a batching change last week. If it's that, good catch.
Josh (Catalyst SI): quick test with max_batch_size=4 — tail lat drops to 1.9s but QPS suffers. We need to hit SLA for Acme's snips pipeline.
Daniela: propose temporary route: use a smaller model variant (rwd-llama-7b-q4) for high-concurrency endpoints and keep 13b for long-context jobs. Can we automate fallback in smart routing?
Marta: yes — we can add a route policy: if concurrency>200 AND avg_latency>3s -> route to 7b. It's config only.
Raj: also open an escalation for Marketplace packaging — hardware vendor driver (NVIDIA 525.x) was flagged in their compat matrix. Eng-infra to coordinate rollback test.
Chen: I'll create a canary rollout with 10% traffic to 7b variant and add a telemetry set: latency, failure_rate, memory_pressure. Use this eval set: `marketplace_onboard_acme_v1`
Josh (Catalyst SI): thanks. ETA for canary? customer is starting integration calls tomorrow.
Daniela: Chen and Raj — can we have canary live by EOD PST? I can test with SI scripts.
Chen: yes — will push canary at 18:00 PST, will post the rollout link and Prometheus dashboards.
Marta: perfect. Josh — please hold off full-scale tests until canary is stable. Also, add the SI runbook steps to the ticket.
deploy-bot: [deploy] Canary rollout initiated by chen at 2026-03-21T18:00:12Z -> 10% traffic to rwd-llama-7b-q4
Josh (Catalyst SI): got it. I'll coordinate with Acme and update the ticket with logs and next test window. :thumbsup:
